header.description: What the model would say at each of two layers: the residual stream at the last token of layers 0 and 1, read through the final norm and head, and the three most likely tokens at each with their probabilities. One read at two layers is one value, so `top_k` lists them layer by layer, a table row per layer and example. Authored for mini. Tiny CPU Llama, so the tokens demonstrate the mechanism and nothing else.
